title: Editor occasionally segfaults when multiple fonts are imported in a project
body:
### Tested versions

v4.5.stable.official.876b29033
v4.6.dev.custom_build.8d8041bd4

### System information

Godot v4.5.stable - Linux Mint 22.2 (Zara) on X11 - X11 display driver, Multi-window, 2 monitors - Vulkan (Forward+) - dedicated NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4070 (nvidia; 580.82.07) - AMD Ryzen 7 7700X 8-Core Processor (16 threads) - 30.46 GiB memory

### Issue description

On import of BOTH of these fonts (PixelatedElegance and Roboto-Bold) but seemingly not either single one, the editor will error about half the time on first import.

### Steps to reproduce

```bash
for i in {1..10}
do
  ./godot.linuxbsd.editor.x86_64.llvm --import ./font-import-segfault/project.godot && rm -r ./font-import-segfault/.godot
done
```
